 Christian Braun struggles Thursday 
 by Ari Koslow | Nuggets Correspondent | Fri, Oct 23rd 2026, 2:12am EDT 
 Christian Braun scored seven points (3-10 FG, 1-6 3PT) to go along with six rebounds, one assist and one steal in the Nuggets 96-84 loss against the Thunder. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 It was a struggle shooting the ball for the entire Nuggets team in their season opener. They'll look to bounce back on Saturday against the Pelicans.
